desc:
🏍️ TRACTION – realistic dirt bikes with real physics (BETA)

Real suspension, real weight transfer and wheelies you balance yourself. Ride enduro, motocross and supermoto bikes in the most realistic dirt bike game on Roblox.

🌆 BIG CITY – traffic lights, a car park you can ride to the roof, a plaza and a park with dirt jumps
🛣️ ENDLESS HIGHWAY – lane-split through traffic, tunnels, bridges and rest stops
🏁 TESTING GROUND – jumps, a loop, a wheelie strip and a drift pad
🌅 DAY & NIGHT – sunsets, headlights and city lights
🤸 TRICKS – wheelies, stoppies, knee knocker, one-hander and Superman
🪖 GEAR & PAINT – helmets, riding kits and bike colours
🪙 Earn coins, finish challenges and climb the leaderboards

PC: W/S gas & brake, A/D steer, Shift wheelie, S + Ctrl stoppie, Space rear brake, 1/2/3 tricks
Controller and phone supported

Bike models from Sketchfab (CC BY 4.0), modified for this game: Motocross 3D, Jacobdesigns, Hari Yojuta.
